scenes.narration: How does Microsoft keep about 47 cents of every dollar it makes?
In fiscal 2026, it made 331.8 billion dollars. 155.2 billion of that was operating income.
That's an operating margin of about 47 percent.
The cloud leads. Then Office and business software. Windows and Xbox come third.
Azure passed 100 billion dollars in a year. Copilot has over 30 million paid seats.
